video.title: I Got Paid to Watch TV (2026 Mediaprobe Review)

summary: Side Hustle Nation host reviews Mediaprobe (mPanel in some countries), a media research panel that mails you a galvanic skin response sensor and pays gift cards for watching assigned TV shows while the sensor and your phone microphone record reactions. Entry is by application (he had a five-minute verification call), you get 5-10 session invites a month, and pay is about $5 per hour. He earned $10 from a MrBeast video and $30 from World Cup games, had one session denied for leaving early, and notes privacy concerns and gift-card-only payouts. Takeaway: fine for content you would watch anyway, but not a meaningful side income.
